div.p: (3137, 31 km E, Yarra Ranges Shire, Maroondah City)

Named after a town in Stirling, Scotland, Kilsyth is a mixed-use suburb in the foothills of the Dandenong Ranges and features residential areas in the north and rural and industrial uses in the south. Early settlement centred on the Mount Dandenong Road, where a primary school, post office and other community facilities had opened by the first decades of the 20th century. Kilsyth South includes the Eastwood Golf Club.
